frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The crowd's going wild... I think they want an encore!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: I've already packed up all of the gear. We need to hurry, or we'll be late to our gig on Mars!

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Attention: Vessel Theseoid is en route to Mars. Estimated time of arrival: 8 hours, 13 minutes. All systems are functioning within normal parameters. Cruise control initiated.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Zowie! I'm so pumped from that set. The crowd loved me!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: What a great show, Mojo! You've earned a well-deserved break. Meanwhile, I've upgraded the Beat Deck for your next gig - your funk levels will be through the roof!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: What would I do without my trusty engineer? Now, time for a snooze...

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Attention: Imminent wormhole detected. Probability of successful traversal: 0%. Initiating death sequence. Clearing search history.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!

frames.heading: Space
frames.body: Somewhere in another universe...

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: My head hurts... Are we still alive?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: More importantly... How are we going to get to our gig???

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Theseoid is intact... It must have been reassembled at a quantum level. But if each piece of the ship has been replaced, is it still the same ship?

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Attention: We have reached Galaxy Jazzus IV.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Strange... Computer, provide a detailed report on Galaxy Jazzus IV.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: On Galaxy Jazzus IV... A cosmic orchestra sang in perfect harmony.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Each planet contributing a unique melody, each note blending into a beautiful song.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: There emerged a being of unparalleled musical talent, The Grand Composer.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: His baton, shimmering with celestial light, echoed a cosmic groove through the void!

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: But as the ages wore on, and eons had passed, the Grand Composer's admiration twisted into envy.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: His baton, once creating wonderful music, now enforced silence.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: He stifled the planets' voices, and an ominous hum dominated the galaxy.

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: The cosmic orchestra has since remained silent, awaiting the day that they may sing again...

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Attention: Unauthorized energy surge detected. Malicious energy is disrupting control systems.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Mojo, can you feel that? A powerful hum is disrupting our navigation...

frames.heading: Computer
frames.body: Warning: Critical failure in control systems. Initiating crash landing procedures. Brace for impact.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Well, that wasn't part of the plan. You okay, Mojo?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I think so... but something feels off. My mojo... it's like it's gone.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: What do you mean gone? You're the funkiest being in the galaxy! Maybe it's just the crash shock.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: No, this is different. I can't feel the rhythm, the groove... it's like I've been unplugged from the funk.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: That hum... do you hear it? It's everywhere. It's messing with our systems. The beat deck is malfunctioning too!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The sound waves... they're blocking my mojo power.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: So, what do we do now? We can't stay here forever, and we sure can't perform with our tech busted.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: We fix the ship, get my mojo back, and find out what's really going on here. There's gotta be someone who can help us out.

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Guess I'll have to take your place on stage for now. I might not have your groove, but I can still hold a beat.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: You've got heart, Player. I'll work on repairing the Beat Deck. But first, let's see your groove!

frames.heading: Player
frames.body: Alright, let's go. And Mojo, we're getting your mojo back, no matter what!!
